items.title: Davey and Goliath Series
items.description: Religious moral tales are presented through the adventures of young Davey Hansen, his talking dog, Goliath, and Davey's sister, Sally, via charmingly crude clay animation. The show, geared toward kids, deals with issues including respecting authority and sharing.
